IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Capital Budget.

Bill.BriefDescription: Fostering economic development by encouraging increased productivity on certain working lands through transfers in ownership.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fostering economic development by encouragingincreased productivity on certain working lands through transfers inownership; amending RCW 79.11.010 and 79.11.090; adding a new sectionto chapter 79.11 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.33A RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 8.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.11 RCWunder the subchapter heading "part 1 sales procedures" to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall develop and the board shall implement aplan to divest the state by December 31, 2021, of all state lands andstate forest lands that are not being actively used for forestry andall lands under state title condemned under section 3 of this act. (2) In implementing the divestiture plan required under thissection, the department shall ensure that the lands sold receive fairmarket value from private sector purchasers under the provisions ofthis chapter. (3) Any trust beneficiary affected by the divestiture of statelands or state forest lands under this section must be made whole by p. 1 HB 1199the provisions of the divestiture plan. The final proceeds of landsales conducted pursuant to the divestiture plan must be transmitted tothe state investment board created in chapter 43.33A RCW to be managedin an investment trust for the affected beneficiaries.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.33A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state investment board must work closely with the board ofnatural resources to implement the state land divestiture plan requiredunder section 1 of this act and ensure that revenue produced from theensuing land sales are accounted for and managed according to thefiduciary duty of the state with regard to the trust beneficiaries thatare affected by the sales.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 8.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The attorney general is authorized and empowered to condemnland owned by the federal government on the effective date of thissection that is forested or available for active forestry uses. (2)(a) Land acquired by the state under this section must be madeavailable for sale to private landowners for active forestry uses undersection 1 of this act; and (b) The acquisition and sale of land condemned under this sectionare deemed to be for a state purpose and public use.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.11.010 and 2003 c 334 s 321 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in section 1 of this act, not more than onehundred and sixty acres of any land granted to the state by the UnitedStates shall be offered for sale in one parcel and no university landsshall be offered for sale except by legislative directive or with theconsent of the board of regents of the University of Washington. (2) Any land granted to the state by the United States may be soldfor any lawful purpose in such minimum acreage as may be fixed by thedepartment or the legislature.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.11.090 and 2003 c 334 s 352 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in RCW 79.11.340, all sales of land underthis chapter shall be at public auction, to the highest bidder, on theterms prescribed by law and as specified in the notice provided underRCW 79.11.120, and no land shall be sold for less than its appraisedvalue. (2) In implementing the divestiture plan required in section 1 of this act, the board shall ensure that land sales are awarded to thehighest private sector bidder.
